background.description: Page background. Every route sits on this.

use.en: Page background. Every route sits on this.

foreground.description: Body text on any dark surface.

use.en: Body text on any dark surface.

surface.description: Section blocks that need to separate from the page.

use.en: Section blocks that need to separate from the page.

note.en: Often used at partial opacity (`bg-surface/40`) to soften the step between sections.

surface-elevated.description: The topmost surface: raised panels inside a section.

use.en: The topmost surface: raised panels inside a section.
shadcn card background.

note.en: Darker than --surface-elevated despite both describing cards. Site sections use --surface-elevated; only shadcn primitives read this token.

use.en: Text inside a shadcn card.

popover.description: Floating surfaces: dropdown, popover, command, tooltip panels.

use.en: Floating surfaces: dropdown, popover, command, tooltip panels.
Text on floating surfaces.

primary.description: shadcn's primary slot — what `Button`, `Switch`, and friends render.

use.en: shadcn's primary slot — what `Button`, `Switch`, and friends render.

note.en: A third copper, lighter than --copper and not part of the published scale. Site components should reach for --copper; --primary exists so unmodified shadcn primitives stay on-brand. Worth reconciling.

primary-foreground.description: Text on a copper fill. Near-black, not white — copper is too light to carry white text at AA.

use.en: Text on a copper fill. Near-black, not white — copper is too light to carry white text at AA.
Secondary button and badge fills.
Text on --secondary.

muted.description: Recessed blocks: table headers, skeletons, disabled fills.

use.en: Recessed blocks: table headers, skeletons, disabled fills.

muted-foreground.description: Secondary text. Carries most body copy on this site — the sections lead with foreground headlines and muted paragraphs.

use.en: Secondary text. Carries most body copy on this site — the sections lead with foreground headlines and muted paragraphs.

accent.description: Hover fill for menu and list items.

use.en: Hover fill for menu and list items.

note.en: Not a brand colour despite the name — it is shadcn's neutral hover slot. Brand accent is --copper.

use.en: Text on --accent.

copper.description: The brand accent in the interface: eyebrow labels, links, emphasis, primary buttons.

use.en: The brand accent in the interface: eyebrow labels, links, emphasis, primary buttons.

note.en: Published as Copper Light in the media kit. This is the value site components use directly (`bg-copper`, `text-copper`).

copper-glow.description: Hover and active states only. Never a resting colour and never a large fill.

use.en: Hover and active states only. Never a resting colour and never a large fill.

gold.description: Figure emphasis — the number in a stat, not the label around it.

use.en: Figure emphasis — the number in a stat, not the label around it.

steppe.description: Mongolian asset context. The only green that is not a status.

use.en: Mongolian asset context. The only green that is not a status.
Secondary backgrounds in asset-context artwork.

positive.description: Confirmed state — secured, verified, on-chain. Also the live-dot pulse.

use.en: Confirmed state — secured, verified, on-chain. Also the live-dot pulse.

alert.description: Attention, not failure. Provisional and in-progress states.

use.en: Attention, not failure. Provisional and in-progress states.
Irreversible actions and hard errors.

note.en: Red, and the only token outside the warm/neutral system. That is the point: it should look foreign.

destructive-text.description: Destructive meaning as text on a dark surface.

use.en: Destructive meaning as text on a dark surface.

note.en: A fill colour and a text colour cannot be the same swatch here. `destructive` is dark enough to carry near-white text on top of it (4.72:1), which is exactly why it fails as text on our dark surfaces (3.80:1 on background). This token is the lighter twin, and it is the one to reach for whenever the red is a word rather than a shape.

use.en: Text on a destructive fill.

border.description: Default hairline. Applied globally to every element in @layer base.

use.en: Default hairline. Applied globally to every element in @layer base.

note.en: Alpha-channel white, so it never appeared in the generated hex palette. Use the .hairline-t / .hairline-b utilities rather than a raw border.

border-strong.description: Emphasised divider where the default hairline disappears.

use.en: Emphasised divider where the default hairline disappears.

input.description: Form field borders. Brighter than --border so an input reads as interactive.

use.en: Form field borders. Brighter than --border so an input reads as interactive.

ring.description: Focus ring. Identical to --primary, so keyboard focus is unmistakably the brand accent.

use.en: Focus ring. Identical to --primary, so keyboard focus is unmistakably the brand accent.

print-copper-deep.description: Light backgrounds and print. Whitepaper covers, rules, callout borders.

use.en: Light backgrounds and print. Whitepaper covers, rules, callout borders.

print-copper.description: The mark itself, plus icons and social artwork. Not a text colour.

use.en: The mark itself, plus icons and social artwork. Not a text colour.
Print background.
Print body text.
Print secondary text.
Print dividers.
Badges, tags, inline chips.
Buttons and inputs. The default.
Cards and panels.
Dialogs and sheets. The ceiling.

radius.description: Base radius consumed by shadcn primitives.

use.en: Base radius consumed by shadcn primitives.

font-sans.description: Body copy and interface text. The document default.

use.en: Body copy and interface text. The document default.

font-display.description: Headlines and figures. Always with -0.02em tracking via .font-display.

use.en: Headlines and figures. Always with -0.02em tracking via .font-display.

note.en: Falls back to Inter, not a system serif — a headline that loses its webfont should still look like this site.

font-mono.description: Eyebrow labels and data. Never body copy.

use.en: Eyebrow labels and data. Never body copy.
